scope: offline bounded mushroom color-fidelity experiment; prototype evidence only; no catalog admission

proposedChange.intent: Use additional vertex budget for the existing adaptive texture bake while preserving the conforming topology pass.

topology.note: No topology report was saved for this transient run; these measurements are preserved from the worker run record and are not independently verifiable here.

decision.reason: The recovered front/rear views still show jagged white-spot edges, so this extra-budget experiment did not demonstrate an improvement. The worker-reported small-area measurement is retained as an unresolved topology concern, not as independently verified evidence.

recommendedNextStep: Plan a separate bounded loader/transfer/material/export integration that deliberately preserves texture data or produces a self-contained image-backed GLB, then rerun the same isolated front/rear and topology checks before any catalog admission. This experiment alone does not establish a universal limit for vertex colors.

rootReview.decision: Rejected: front white-spot fringes visibly worse than baseline. No source change retained.
rootReview.topology: Unverified experiment counts are not acceptance evidence.
